Byte-Latent Glossary

This page defines the core terms used across Gollek’s Byte-Latent modeling, inspection, workflow, and compare docs.

Use it when you understand the general flow but want a fast vocabulary reference for artifact names and inspector language.

Terms

baseline report

The earlier train-infer-report.json artifact used as the left-hand or comparison-anchor side in a Byte-Latent train+infer compare flow.

bundle

A generated directory of inspection artifacts exported by one of the Byte-Latent inspectors. A bundle usually includes multiple rendered files and a manifest.json.

bundle health

A compact integrity view over a bundle that answers whether the bundle is complete, which files are missing, and whether any grouped section or format rollups show gaps.

checkpoint directory

The trainer output directory that contains one run’s persisted Byte-Latent artifacts, such as byte-latent-summary.json, byte-latent-history.csv, and byte-latent-report.json.

commands:ci

A compact inspector selector that returns the shortest high-signal follow-up commands for CI or terminal-first usage.

compare bundle

A reusable exported artifact directory written by trainer_byte_latent_train_infer_compare_inspector.java from two train-infer-report.json inputs.

compare inspector

The JBang entrypoint trainer_byte_latent_train_infer_compare_inspector.java, used for direct baseline-vs-current comparisons and compare bundle reopen flows.

compare summary

A compact comparison view that summarizes the highest-signal baseline-vs-current differences without reopening the whole structured compare payload.

current report

The newer train-infer-report.json artifact being compared against a baseline report.

delta selector

A compare-oriented selector of the form delta:<field>, used to extract one focused baseline-vs-current difference such as delta:latestTrainLoss or delta:combinedText.

files summary

A grouped rollup over generated bundle files, typically keyed by section or format through selectors such as filesSummary:by=section.

history inspector

The JBang entrypoint trainer_byte_latent_history_inspector.java, used for one-run checkpoint status, health, summary, and epoch-history queries.

history row

One persisted epoch-level row in byte-latent-history.csv, representing a single observed step in the training timeline.

inspectfields

A selector family that advertises the stable machine-readable fields exposed by an inspector or exported artifact.

loadfile

A selector family for reopening one generated file from a bundle, optionally by section, index, or pick mode such as first/last.

nextTokensPreview

A compact preview-oriented representation of the ranked next-token output used in train+infer artifacts and compare flows.

one-run inspection

The checkpoint-oriented path where you inspect one trainer output directory without comparing it against another report.

report version

The schema marker persisted into train+infer or compare artifacts so downstream tools can tell which stable artifact contract they are reading.

runcommands

A workflow-manifest selector family that advertises the most useful follow-up commands for one fresh/resume run or for the whole multi-run manifest.

runfields

A workflow-manifest selector family that advertises the machine-readable field surface for one run or the compact run-discovery view.

selector

A compact terminal grammar string passed to a Byte-Latent inspector to choose one summary, one filtered slice, one artifact view, or one bundle operation.

train+infer inspector

The JBang entrypoint trainer_byte_latent_train_infer_inspector.java, used for reading one persisted train-infer-report.json artifact.

train-infer report

The persisted artifact train-infer-report.json that combines training-side and inference-side output for one Byte-Latent run.

two-report comparison

The workflow where a baseline report and a current report are compared either directly in the terminal or through an exported compare bundle.

workflow bundle

A reusable artifact directory exported from a workflow manifest through the workflow inspector.

workflow inspector

The JBang entrypoint trainer_byte_latent_workflow_inspector.java, used for fresh/resume/full workflow manifest inspection and workflow bundle reopen flows.

workflow manifest

The JSON artifact written by the unified workflow launcher that records the fresh/resume/full run layout, follow-up commands, bundle location, and compact workflow metadata.
